info.longBusinessSummary: Adient plc engages in the design, development, manufacture, and market of seating systems and components for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and light trucks. Its automotive seating solutions include complete seating systems, mechanisms, frames, foams, head restraints, armrests, and trim covers. The company serves automotive original equipment manufacturers in North America and South America; Europe, Middle East, and Africa; and Asia. Adient plc was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
